positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: Where does the durable value of intelligence reside: in the substrate that produces it, or in the perspective a person keeps?
positions.why: Both expressions are antithetical maxims set in the same contrastive frame, opposing owned to rented intelligence (src-3) and commodity substrate to kept perspective (src-4). Read in the direction of where lasting value sits, they hold one reading. The register is compressed and aphoristic, so the group reads as a maxim pair rather than an argued position. No existing strata or structure is supplied, so no home is offered.
